answers.core:
This is completely expected behavior when working with animation trees and should not be a third party add-on.
You can already create AnimationNodeStateMachines as root and save and share them, so you should be able to do the same thing from within a AnimationNodeBlendTree.
answers.workaround: I doubt the vast majority of people is able to write a editor script for this.

title: Add ability to save AnimationnoedStateMachine resource from within AnimationNodeBlendTree (or other nested tree roots)
